implementation.title: Implement MetricsCalculator class
implementation.description: Add MetricsCalculator class to synapse/backtest/metrics.py. Constructor accepts risk_free_rate, annualization_factor, and optional benchmark_returns. The compute() method takes a numpy array of portfolio returns and returns a frozen PerformanceMetrics dataclass. Uses stateful accumulation pattern: initialize counters (cum_return, peak, wins, losses, win_sum, loss_sum, running_sum, running_sq), iterate once through returns updating all counters, then compute all 8 metrics from accumulated state.
modification_points: Add MetricsCalculator class to metrics.py with __init__(risk_free_rate, annualization_factor, benchmark)
Add compute() method: takes np.ndarray returns, returns frozen PerformanceMetrics
Implement single-pass accumulation: cum_return, peak, drawdown tracking, win/loss counters, running stats

Compute from state: annual_return=(1+total)^(252/n)-1, volatility=std*sqrt(252), sharpe=mean_excess/std_excess*sqrt(252), max_drawdown from cumulative peak, win_rate=count(positive)/total, profit_loss_ratio=mean_positive/abs(mean_negative), calmar=annual_return/abs(max_drawdown), information_ratio=excess/tracking_error*sqrt(252), turnover from portfolio weights
logic_flow: Initialize accumulation state: cum_return=1.0, peak=1.0, wins=0, losses=0, win_sum=0.0, loss_sum=0.0, running_sum=0.0, running_sq=0.0
For each return r(t): update cum_return *= (1+r), peak = max(peak, cum_return), dd = (peak-cum_return)/peak, track max_drawdown, update win/loss counters, update running stats
Finalize: compute all 8 metrics from accumulated state
